sources.browserTitle: EDF announces the signature of an agreement to sell to KKR EDF power solutions in the United States and Canada - 2026/06/30 | Groupe EDF
sources.purpose: Direct seller source confirms a signed sale of the U.S. and Canadian operations, customary conditions, and expected second-half 2026 closing.
Direct buyer source confirms KKR, the U.S./Canada scope, and infrastructure-strategy basis.
Direct KKR source supports the Fund V vehicle attribution.
Current regulatory docket supports continued pending status rather than legal closing.

closingSearch: No legal closing, termination, or replacement buyer was identified through September 1, 2026; EDF remains active and KKR remains pending incoming.
